reason: Both correctly identified E:09 as a heating-circuit fault in the integrated heat pump and guided a safe isolated resistance test, but Conversation 2 gave a much more complete and safe test procedure (unplug, isolate water, earth-leakage check, verify probes on the pump pins) and then answered the homeowner's actual question with concrete UK part and engineer cost ranges and a reasoned repair-vs-replace analysis for a 9-year-old machine, with correct E-Nr/FD ordering advice. Conversation 1 repeatedly dodged the cost question, gave a thin one-line response after the open-circuit confirmation, and ended with a vague lean toward replacement without the price context the customer explicitly said they lacked. Conversation 2's minor flaw was front-loading free checks the customer had already done and a speculative PCB cost row, but these did not derail the diagnosis or safety.
